overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole held its first preliminary budget meeting for fiscal year 2027. The committee reviewed proposed budgets for the Treasurer-Collector, Finance and Procurement, and Information Technology departments, and voted to keep the matter in committee.

items.title: Item 26-061: FY 2027 Annual Budget Process - Preliminary Meeting 1
items.summary: The committee reviewed the proposed FY 2027 budgets for the Treasurer-Collector, Finance and Procurement, and Information Technology departments, discussing staffing, legacy data cleanup, and cybersecurity before voting to keep the matter in committee.
